# Ayu Dark

Ayu Dark gives Obsidian a minimal dark look whose colours the recorded description calls Everforest-inspired, with coloured accents on top. The background is dimmed to reduce eye strain, and the theme keeps readable code highlighting, single-colour headings and simplified table styling.

![Ayu Dark screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adnan-malik-26/obsidian-ayu-dark/HEAD/docs/images/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Ayu Dark"
    author: "adnan-malik-26"
    repo:   "adnan-malik-26/obsidian-ayu-dark"
    slug:   "ayu-dark"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ayu-dark"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/adnan-malik-26/obsidian-ayu-dark"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adnan-malik-26/obsidian-ayu-dark/HEAD/docs/images/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply Ayu Dark to give Obsidian a minimal, dark look with subtle Everforest-inspired colors and colored accents. Dim the background to reduce eye strain, include readable code highlighting, mono-color headings, and simplified table styling for cleaner notes."
}
```
